tests.name: 1. Unit Typing & Scale Verification > verifies per-share metrics are typed as INR_PER_SHARE and unscaled

1. Unit Typing & Scale Verification > verifies ROA is represented as a decimal fraction, not percentage
1. Unit Typing & Scale Verification > verifies monetary aggregates are scaled to INR_CR
2. Period Semantics > verifies discrete periodType taxonomy prevents silent YTD relabeling

3. Scope Separation > verifies CONSOLIDATED and STANDALONE facts have distinct factIds and do not collide
4. Available-At / Point-in-Time Integrity > verifies availableAt strictly exceeds periodEnd with zero future leakage
4. Available-At / Point-in-Time Integrity > verifies availableAt is not substituted with periodEnd
5. Derived Metric Semantics > verifies operating_plus_investing_cash_flow is defined as CFO + CFI
5. Derived Metric Semantics > verifies net_debt_financing_flow is defined as debt_raised - debt_repaid

6. Source-to-Canonical Traceability > verifies promoted facts include full audit traceability
